title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_key_compromise_acknowledged}
description: Phase 8 §8.13.6 — emitted for the audit trail when an operator acknowledges a DR-key compromise and revokes the compromised recipient via ops.dr --add-recipient / --revoke. Notification only.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this notification was emitted.

scope.description: Key scope that was compromised. Currently only 'dr' (disaster-recovery public key).

recipient_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the compromised DR recipient key being revoked.

action.description: Action taken on the compromised key. Currently only 'revoke'.

operator_id.description: Identifier of the operator who acknowledged the compromise (if available).
